operating_contract.autonomy: Ordinary bounded repository implementation, expected CI and non-destructive metadata-overlay work are standing-preapproved under AGENTS.md. No human gate is active. operating_contract.normalization: Raw source country/cuisine/culture/category/tags/diets/difficulty/time/servings remain source hints until a versioned reviewed mapping earns canonical app authority. Historical collection labels are provenance-only. UNKNOWN and AMBIGUOUS are first-class states; no guessing.
operating_contract.storage: Protected recipe bodies remain private in Cloudflare D1. The normalization baseline reconstructed exact pinned public sources and performed zero D1 reads/writes; no protected bodies were exported.
operating_contract.d1: Optimized operational target remains <=8 D1 subqueries/request. Hard fail-safe 16 is not spendable headroom. Preserve exactly two shards and delta-route ancestry.
operating_contract.public_activation: Public runtime remains 85 recipes. Broader public corpus or recommendation admission is not authorized.
operating_contract.billing_firewall: No paid infrastructure, billing enablement or automatic overage authorization.

normalization_baseline.interpretation: Raw source signals are heterogeneous and not semantically interchangeable. Tags/culture are broad but noisy; category and difficulty mix incompatible vocabularies/scales. First implementation must be a reversible overlay with explicit UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS states.
